questions.mathStats:
Q1. Find probability mass function of discrete random variable at one point giving its value at all other points?
Ans:- Sum of probabilities is 1. So subtracted the sum of probabilities of all other points from 1 to get required answer. This took a good amount of time for calculation and gave correct answer.
Q2. Plot the probability mass function of above discrete random variable?
Ans:- I drawn it correctly.
Q3. Find the probability of a continuous discrete random variable to lie between 1 and 2 giving cumulative distribution function (cdf)?
Ans:- If cfd=f(x) then integrate f(x)dx with between lower limit 1 and higher limit 2. I did not solve it completely i drawn the graph and shaded area and wrote the integration form. Interviewer seen the equation and said it correct and not needed to solve completely.
Q4. Find expected value of expected value of discrete random variable in first question?
Ans:- summation of xf(x) from x=-infinity to x=infinity where f(x) is pmf in terms of random variable x. I answered it correctly.
Q5. Find the expected value for the continuous random variable in third question?
Ans:- Integration of xf(x) from x=-infinity to x=infinity where f(x) is cdf I answered it correctly.
Then he asked if i know about situations of two random variables. I said i can do but only to basic level. Interviewer said he will ask basic level questions only and asked.
Q6. Joint pdf of two random variable X and Y is given and asked to find marginal cdf of y where 0<x<y<1.
Ans:- Integrate the x from 0 to y for the joint pdf to get marginal cdf in term of y. I answered it correctly.
Q7. Find the probability of the function now?
Ans:- We have to integrate the maginal cdf in y for its limits 0 to 1 where we get answer as 1. I got confused about the lower limit of integration here weather 0 or x. I took a bit of time in thinking and expressed doubt put x but he said it wrong then changed to 0. Sir( interviewer) later gave reason for it.
Q8. Draw the plot of the joint pdf region?
Ans:- I drawn the region 0<x<y<1 and shaded region on XY axis correctly.

questions.mathStats:
What is the probability that the digits of a randomly selected three-digit number will be in ascending order from left to right (without repetitions)?
 
Answer: 0 can't be a part of the number. So, there are 9 numbers to choose from. When you have selected three digits out of 9, there are 6 permutations possible, out of which only in 1 will the digits be in ascending order from left to right.
So, total number of desired 3-digit numbers = 9C3
Total number of 3-digit numbers = 9*10*10
Probability = (9C3)/900

records.resourcesInterview: I went through the interviews of previous years and made a list of topics to study and go through. But at the end of the day, I've been asked questions only based on whatever I have filled in the interview application form.
